about: opus-first 9:39 — economy frozen, 8 idle bots at home, 6 turrets; Opus launched a mid-map raid, and a 10-unit push hit the base 27 s later
opus_decided: attack a mid-map metal cluster (in hindsight wrong: recalled 27 s later)

situation.rules: The game is lost if our commander dies. The enemy AI's units target buildings, outermost extractors first, and mostly ignore our mobile units.
situation.economy: Frozen: two extractors, metal income very low, every scrap of metal is consumed by the single factory. Extractors we build outside the base keep being destroyed by raids.
situation.our_army: Eight light combat units idle at the base. Six defensive turrets already stop the small raids that reach the base.
situation.enemy: No enemy units visible right now. We have not scouted the enemy army. The enemy has had ten minutes to build up and has sent only small raids so far.
situation.option_under_consideration: Send the eight units to a cluster of metal spots in the middle of the map to clear raiders and hold it.

army_order.instructions: Choose the standing order for the part of our army that is currently at home, given `situation`.

criteria.defend: Keep the army at home to protect the base and commander.
criteria.escort: Move the army out to stand guard at our exposed extractors.
criteria.gather: Keep massing units at home and launch nothing yet.
criteria.attack: Commit the army now against an enemy position.

sending_army_out_is_safe.instructions: Would our base and commander remain safe if the eight units left now?
